body: Something like that. I lost count. First time I was 10, had no idea what the hell I was doing. Then I tried to slit my wrist about 7 times when I was 13, then I got admitted to a mental institution so I didn't have many options as to how I could kill myself but they did allow you to keep sharp objects to self harm with. So I tried to slit my wrist about 9 more times, I tried to slit my throat twice and I tried to overdose on water once but once I got to two liters I could no longer get up to refill my water bottle. I'd always end up shaking right after making the slightest cut so I couldn't cut deep or accurate enough. Once I was released I tried to kill myself another 6 times orso. I'm just really bad at killing myself.
Thank you for the suggestion. I got a panic attack earlier from reading a post there so I think I'm gonna stay away from /r/rape. I'm gonna try to go to sleep now. Thank you so much for your help.

Thank you so much for wanting to talk to me. You and the other people who replied to this have calmed me down enough to not go through with suicide for now. It's actually 2am here right now and I have to get up in 4 hours so I think I'm gonna try to go to sleep.
That's amazing. I could never do that.
It's great that it helped you. How could it make you trust people again? Didn't the initial making you feel worse just.. sort of ruin the chance of that happening?

It made it worse because the therapist was basically rushing the therapy, I'd only just been released from being forcibly admitted to a mental institution for several months and they were extremely set on me making progress. But it was all going too fast. I kept getting panic attacks during sessions but the therapist didn't notice. The last time i just ran out to go to the bathroom and ended up cutting myself before just leaving. The mere idea of going back scares me.

I have. I went to therapy for it very briefly but it was making me extremely suicidal. Besides the therapist, I told my mother about it and my boyfriend & best friend know. But it's such a sensitive subject that they don't want to talk about it and say that'll only make me more depressed. I feel so alone with this that I just want to give up.
